explanation: Understanding x86-64 assembly language is crucial for systems programming because it allows direct manipulation of hardware resources and optimization at the lowest level.  This provides insight into how high-level languages interact with the underlying architecture, enabling better performance tuning and debugging of system-level code. It also reveals the intricacies of memory management and processor operations, critical for writing efficient and secure systems software.
